battle.name: 魏州之戰
battle.brief: 建中三年正月，魏博節度使田悅自洹水戰敗，率殘部千餘人奔魏州，殺閉城拒納之大將李長春，據孤城固抗。河東節度使馬燧、昭義節度使李抱真屯兵平邑，堵塞御河使城中水源斷絕，迫其出戰；二月田悅背城列兵二萬於永濟渠再戰，大敗退回。卡面羅馬方陣盾不在此役現場，其凸面方盾之形即唐軍方盾結陣拒騎之具。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰一方是唐廷與其倚重的兩鎮藩帥：河東節度使馬燧所部、昭義節度使李抱真所部，兩軍合為進討魏博的主力，朝廷以制詔授予節度使、兵馬使、觀察使等名號，節制河北各州。另一方是魏博節度使田悅所守的魏州軍：田承嗣於大曆四年（779年）死後，田悅承襲魏博節度使，節制魏州治貴鄉以及博、洺等州，州刺史與本州兵馬聽其號令，軍中大將如李長春握有城門開闔之權。田悅的兵力由數部分組成，一部分是魏州本地的州兵與將士的家屬部曲，一部分是自山東淄青節度使李正己處南下的淄青兵，由符璘、李瑤帶領者有五百騎兵，後來整建制投向唐軍。官軍陣中還有因戰局倒戈而來的魏博內部力量：博州李再春以城降唐，田悅從兄田昂舉洺州城降唐，占據長橋的王光進亦歸順朝廷，使魏州在河北道腹地陷於孤立。外援一方則是成德與幽州方向的藩鎮武力：朱滔與新任恆冀防禦使王武俊商議引兵救援田悅，兩人各有挾制朝廷、爭取趙州深州的算盤，並非真心為田悅效命。
countriesEn: One side was the Tang court together with the two circuits it relied upon: the army of Hedong jiedushi Ma Xu and the army of Zhaoyi jiedushi Li Baozhen, which together formed the main striking force against Weibo, while the court kept control of the prefectures of Hebei by issuing edicts that appointed jiedushi, bingmashi and guanchashi. The other side was the Weizhou army of Weibo jiedushi Tian Yue. After Tian Chengsi died in 779, Tian Yue inherited the office of Weibo jiedushi and controlled the seat of Weizhou at Guixiang as well as the prefectures of Bo and Ming; the prefects and the prefectural troops answered to him, and generals such as Li Changchun held the right to open and close the city gates. Tian Yue's force was composed of several elements: local prefectural soldiers and the private retinues of officers and their families, and troops sent south from Ziqing jiedushi Li Zhengji in Shandong, five hundred of them cavalry under Fu Lin and Li Yao, who eventually deserted in a body to the Tang side. The imperial camp also drew in Weibo defectors: Li Zaichun surrendered the city of Bo, Tian Yue's cousin Tian Ang surrendered Ming, and Wang Guangjin, who held the bridge position at Changqiao, also came over to the court, leaving Weizhou isolated in the belly of Hebei. The relief force came from the Chengde and Youzhou directions: Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun, the newly appointed Hengji fangyushi, discussed marching to rescue Tian Yue, each of them less keen to serve Tian Yue than to put pressure on the court and to press their own claims to Zhaozhou and Shen Prefecture.
people: 田悅是魏博節度使，本役守方的主角；其父田承嗣經營魏州近二十年，留下半獨立的人事與財政，兒子承接之後卻在河北道再度用兵，與成德交惡，魏州之戰正是那場反亂的延續。河東節度使馬燧與昭義節度使李抱真指揮唐軍圍逼魏州；馬燧自洹水追擊後屯兵平邑，李抱真自西南方向策應，兩人起初配合不順，田悅因此得以喘息。魏州大將李長春在城郊關閉城門，拒絕收納敗退的主帥，等到天明才開門放行；田悅入城後將李長春殺死，藉此清除城內異己，隨即緊閉城門拒絕出戰。博州李再春以城降唐、田悅從兄田昂舉洺州降唐、占據長橋的王光進歸順朝廷，這三人把魏州的外圍一個個挖去。田悅所遣軍使符璘與李瑤，藉率領五百騎兵淄青兵回駐原地的機會，率部向馬燧投降，成為守軍內部最直接的一記裂口。田悅又派許士則、侯藏徒步間行出城，潛往游說朱滔與王武俊出兵相救。朝廷方面，恆冀防禦使王武俊於二月將成德節度使李惟嶽首級傳送京師，易定節度使張孝忠與趙深二州觀察使康日知皆受封命，河北道的人事版圖因此重畫。唐德宗李適在遠方遙控，發詔授命、許以節度使名號；淄青節度使李正己與淮西節度使李希烈同屬這次連動叛亂的藩帥。
peopleEn: Tian Yue, jiedushi of Weibo, was the principal figure on the defensive side. His father Tian Chengsi had governed Weizhou for nearly twenty years and left behind a half-independent personnel and fiscal apparatus; the son inherited it and immediately went back to war in Hebei, quarrelling with Chengde, so the battle of Weizhou was a continuation of that rising. Ma Xu, jiedushi of Hedong, and Li Baozhen, jiedushi of Zhaoyi, commanded the Tang forces that pressed the city: Ma Xu followed up after the defeat at Huanqiu and camped at Pingyi, Li Baozhen supported him from the south-west, and the two did not work well together at first, which gave Tian Yue room to recover. Li Changchun, a great general of Weizhou, shut the city gates when the defeated commander reached the outskirts and refused to admit him, opening them only at daybreak; once inside, Tian Yue had Li Changchun killed, thereby removing the one man inside who opposed him, and then kept the gates closed and refused to fight in the open. Li Zaichun surrendered Bo with its city, Tian Yue's cousin Tian Ang surrendered Ming, and Wang Guangjin, who held the bridge at Changqiao, came over to the court; one by one they peeled the ring around Weizhou away. Fu Lin and Li Yao, the envoys Tian Yue sent out, took the chance given by their mission of leading five hundred Ziqing cavalry back to their old station and surrendered with them to Ma Xu, which opened the deepest crack in the defenders. Tian Yue then dispatched Xu Shize and Hou Zang, who walked out of the city by night to sound out Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun and press them to send relief. On the court side, Hengji fangyushi Wang Wujun sent the head of Chengde jiedushi Li Weiyue to the capital in the second month, and Yiding jiedushi Zhang Xiaozhong as well as Kang Rizhi, observer of Zhaozhou and Shen Prefecture, were confirmed in office, so the map of Hebei was redrawn. Emperor Dezong Li Shi ruled from afar, dispensing appointments and ratifying jiedushi titles; Ziqing jiedushi Li Zhengji and Huai western jiedushi Li Xilie belonged to the same cluster of rebellious circuits in this rising.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾是前100年前後羅馬步兵的標準防具：凸面長方，形制略呈弧形，可以遮住軀幹，一手握持、一臂負重，盾緣互相咬合成連續防線，盾面中央可加盾凸以格擋刺擊，羅馬人還在盾上纏布或包金屬片以承受投射物的打擊。它並不在魏州戰場上，唐軍從未使用過羅馬制式的方陣盾，把它放上這張卡是取其「凸面長方盾」這一器物類型，用來對照本役的防具譜系。唐代步兵的同類防具是木胎蒙皮或蒙帛的方盾，兵書多稱方盾、步盾，形制同樣是縱長方形，結陣時前排持盾抵禦騎兵衝鋒與矢石打擊，後排以弓弩、槊、刀補上；這是唐軍在平邑至魏州一線野戰的基本依托。攻城一方使用外蒙牛皮或木板、可推可撞的攻車與蒙衝，可遠射的投石機（唐人稱砲），以及能連發的攻城弩、飛梯；防守一方則在城門與通道上置拒馬、鹿角、木柵，壘土為營，環城引水成壕，並以礪石、弓弩、標槊拒敵於城頭與牆根。河東、昭義兩鎮的兵以長刀、槊、角弓為主，騎兵用馬槊與弓箭；魏州守軍同樣以弓弩、標槊應戰，並依靠城垣與甕城保護。卡面那一面羅馬方陣盾，與本役唐軍手中握的方盾，在形制上同屬「縱長方盾接合成列」的路數，但它只是器物原型對照，並非戰場所用之器。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card face was the standard defensive arm of Roman infantry around 100 BC: a convex rectangle, slightly curved in outline, wide enough to cover the torso, carried in one hand and supported on the forearm, with the edges butting against one another to form a continuous line, a central boss added on the face to turn aside thrusts, and cloth or metal facing applied over the board to take the punishment of missiles. It was not on the field at Weizhou, and Tang soldiers never used a Roman-pattern scutum; the card uses it as an illustration of the artefact type, the convex rectangular shield, to set against the defensive equipment actually present in this campaign. The Tang equivalent was a rectangular shield of wood faced with hide or cloth, called fangdun or budun in the military manuals, likewise elongated in shape: in the line the front rank held these shields against cavalry charges and missiles while the ranks behind worked bows, crossbows, spears and sabres. The besiegers had wheeled assault carts and covered rams faced with hide or plank, stone-throwing engines that the Tang called pao, siege crossbows and scaling ladders; the defenders blocked the gates and passages with juma and deer-horn obstacles and timber fences, piled earth into camps, ringed the walls with a water ditch, and answered from the parapets with thrown stones, bows and javelins. The Hedong and Zhaoyi troops fought with long sabres, spears and composite bows, their cavalry using mounted lances and arrows, while the Weizhou garrison replied with bows, crossbows and javelins behind its walls and barbicans. The scutum on the card belongs, in form, to the same school as the rectangular shields the Tang used here, but it is a typological parallel and not a weapon of the battlefield.
tactics: 本役的戰術主軸是「斷水逼戰」與「離心分化」。田悅自洹水戰敗，退抵魏州城西郊時，軍中與城內互相猜疑，大將李長春一度關閉城門不納，等到天明才放他入城，田悅殺李長春之後緊閉城門，拒絕任何形式的野戰。馬燧與李抱真不急於強攻：兩軍屯兵平邑，先以封鎖博、洺等屬州、招納內應（李再春、田昂、王光進相繼歸順）的方式孤立魏州，再切中城防最脆弱的一環——魏州城引御河即永濟渠之水入城南流，唐軍堵住入城河口，使城內水源斷絕、人心震動，田悅不得不派使者徒步間行潛出，說動朱滔與王武俊出兵相救。田悅的野戰部署也有可取之處：他倚城而營，採背城列陣之勢，把進退之地限在城垣與御河之間的窄地，意圖以城為依托抵擋官軍推進；但援軍未至而人心先散，二月出戰的兩萬人一旦失去背靠的城垣掩護，就在永濟渠兩岸被官軍的騎兵與步卒配合擊潰，潰兵退入城中，官軍的封圈反而收得更緊。守方能守不能走、主動出戰等於自棄城垣優勢，是這場戰役最終落敗的關鍵。
tacticsEn: The operational character of this campaign was a combination of cutting off the defender's water and splitting his command. After the defeat at Huanqiu, Tian Yue withdrew to the southern outskirts of Weizhou, where army and city distrusted one another: Li Changchun once shut the gates against his own commander and only admitted him at daybreak, and after killing Li Changchun Tian Yue closed the city and refused any battle in the open. Ma Xu and Li Baozhen did not rush the walls. They camped at Pingyi, first isolating Weizhou by cutting off the dependent prefectures of Bo and Ming and taking in defectors one after another, Li Zaichun, Tian Ang and Wang Guangjin, and then went for the weakest point of the city's defences: Weizhou drew water from the Yuhe, that is the Yongji Canal, which ran out of the city towards the south, and the Tang troops dammed the inlet until the flow stopped, so that the water inside failed and panic spread in the streets. Tian Yue was thus obliged to send emissaries out on foot at night to sound out Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun for relief. His field deployment had its own logic: he camped against the city and formed up with his back to the walls, restricting his ground to the narrow strip between the rampart and the canal in the hope of holding the line with the city behind him. But the relief never came and his own men were already wavering; when two ten thousand men marched out in the second month they surrendered the shelter of the walls, and they were broken on both banks of the Yongji Canal by the combination of imperial cavalry and infantry, the fugitives falling back inside the city and the cordon closing tighter. The defence could hold but could not leave, and by choosing to fight in the open it gave up its advantage of the walls; that decision was what decided the campaign.
data: 可考的數字有限，但《資治通鑑》卷二百二十七唐紀四十三記下幾個明確數目：建中三年（782年）正月，田悅自洹水之敗逃回魏州時只餘殘部千餘人，這是他兵力的底數；到二月出戰，他背城列陣的軍隊為二萬，說明兩個月間關外部隊與援兵重新集結。符璘、李瑤奉命率領的淄青兵為五百騎兵，人數不多，卻在關鍵時刻整建制投向唐軍。地理尺度上，魏州治貴鄉在今河北大名縣東北，與西南方向的平邑（今南樂縣東北）相距不過數十里，兩軍接觸極近；東面的博州治聊城、洺州治永年、魏州與平邑之間的永濟渠，是本役的實際交戰線。田悅派往朱滔、王武俊處的使者許士則、侯藏是徒步間行，說明兩城之間往來要避開官軍封鎖。唐軍方面的確切人數史載未詳，只能由河東、昭義兩大節度使全軍出動推測其相當可觀；魏州城牆周長、城樓與城門的數目則無記載，只能按唐代州城通制推測有內外城、甕城與環壕。本役自正月兵敗退入魏州到二月再敗，前後不過一個月。
dataEn: The record is thin, but the Zizhi Tongjian, scroll 227, gives several firm figures. In the first month of the third year of Jianzhong, 782, Tian Yue fled back to Weizhou after the defeat at Huanqiu with no more than a little over a thousand men left; that was the base of his strength. By the second month, when he deployed outside the walls, the army numbered twenty thousand, which shows external contingents and reinforcements gathering in the two months between. The Ziqing troops under Fu Lin and Li Yao were five hundred cavalry; a small body, but they changed sides entire, at a decisive moment. In geographical terms the seat of Weizhou at Guixiang lies to the north-east of Daming County in modern Hebei, only some tens of li from Pingyi to the south-west, in modern Nanle County, so the two armies were in close contact; Bo at Liaocheng in the east, Ming at Yongnian, and the Yongji Canal between Weizhou and Pingyi formed the actual line of the campaign. Xu Shize and Hou Zang, whom Tian Yue sent to Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun, travelled on foot and by night, which shows that movement between the two camps had to avoid the imperial cordon. No exact figure survives for the Tang army, and the presence of two jiedushi in full strength implies a substantial force; the circumference of the walls, the number of towers and gates of Weizhou, are not recorded, and can only be inferred from the general Tang prefectural pattern with an inner and outer wall, a barbican and a surrounding ditch. From the first defeat to the second the campaign lasted barely a month.
cause: 起事根源在德宗削藩與藩鎮承襲權之爭。成德節度使李寶臣於建中三年初病故，其子李惟嶽以軍中推舉自代，朝廷對此生出防範，河北道各鎮互相攻伐，魏博與成德交惡，戰端重開。田悅不肯受朝廷節制，先後與李惟嶽、淄青節度使李正己、淮西節度使李希烈相呼應，河北、河南兩道藩鎮聯動，使朝廷無法集中一路兵力。朝廷方面的壓力來自財政與制度：建中年間推行兩稅法、括戶、增收進奉，直接觸及藩鎮向心力與州縣錢糧，加重部曲與將士的怨望；同時裁抑節度使承襲的慣例，試圖把兵權與人事收回中央。田悅之叛正是對這套政策的直接回應，他的出兵與河北各鎮的自保同時指向一個目標：讓中央無法單獨解決任何一路。於是本役實為「征討田悅」的一環，馬燧與李抱真奉命討平河北叛軍，先在洹水取勝，再乘勝進逼田悅的老巢魏州。
causeEn: The revolt grew out of the court's attempt to curb the regional military governors and out of the dispute over how those offices should pass down. Chengde jiedushi Li Baochen died early in the third year of Jianzhong and his son Li Weiyue succeeded on the strength of the army's own acclaim; the court grew wary, the circuits of Hebei began to fight one another, and Weibo fell out with Chengde, reopening the war in the north. Tian Yue would not accept the court's control and answered in step with Li Weiyue, with Ziqing jiedushi Li Zhengji and with Huai western jiedushi Li Xilie, so that the circuits of Hebei and Henan rose together and the court could never concentrate against any one of them. The pressure from the court side was fiscal and institutional. The two-tax system, the registration of hidden households and the increase in remittances imposed during the Jianzhong years reached straight into the governors' power base and into the money and grain of the prefectures, and they deepened the resentment of officers and private troops; at the same time the court curtailed the custom by which a circuit passed to a son or an appointed heir, in an attempt to bring appointments and troops back under central control. Tian Yue's rising was a direct answer to that policy, and his war in Hebei aimed at the same target as every other circuit's self-preservation: to make it impossible for the centre to defeat any single circuit. This campaign was therefore one stage of the punitive expedition against Tian Yue, in which Ma Xu and Li Baozhen, charged with putting down the northern rebels, first won at Huanqiu and then pressed on to Tian Yue's own seat at Weizhou.
impact: 魏州之戰是德宗一朝削藩失敗的一個標尺。官軍在洹水取勝、在魏州城下屢挫田悅，卻未能攻下孤城，反被迫長期圍困；同年稍後淮西李希烈與淄青李正己的叛亂相繼平定受挫，涇原兵變又牽出涇原、涇渭之亂，朱泚一度據長安稱帝，河北道的叛亂與關中的叛亂互相呼應，最終朝廷靠借用外族與沙陀部落的武力才恢復對關中的控制，中央威信在這一輪衝擊中消耗殆盡，藩鎮割據的局面不減反增。田悅仍保有魏博節度使，河北道的趙州、深州因朝廷分置觀察使與新節度使而裂成更多小鎮，節度使與觀察使互相猜忌，河北遂成五代藩鎮割據最深的區域之一，節度使連續殺死自己的上司以拒絕朝廷任命，河北因而長期未能安定。技術層面上，本役留下的兩個做法都被後世沿用：以堵斷城內水源代替強攻的困城戰術，以及據城、斷水、招降三管齊下孤立敵將的方略，前者見於後來唐宋之間的多次圍城，後者則是唐代節度使征討藩鎮的常法。武器上則延續了中方盾的傳統，直到唐末藩鎮割據時期，方盾才逐漸被以中心體為主的圓盾與鎧甲取代。
impactEn: The battle of Weizhou is a measure of how far the Dezong court's attempt to curb the governors failed. The imperial forces won at Huanqiu and repeatedly beat Tian Yue before the walls of Weizhou, yet they never took the isolated city and were forced into a long blockade instead. Later in the same year the revolts of Huai west and Ziqing were quashed only in part, the Jingyuan mutiny set off the Jingyuan and Jingwei disturbances, and Zhu Ci for a time held the capital of Chang'an as emperor; the rebellions of Hebei and of Guanzhong answered one another, and the court recovered control of the capital only by calling on foreign and Shatuo auxiliaries. Central authority was exhausted by that round of blows, and the pattern of autonomous circuits grew deeper rather than shallower. Tian Yue kept the office of Weibo jiedushi, while the division of Zhaozhou and Shen Prefecture and the appointment of new governors and observers broke Hebei into still smaller circuits, jiedushi and observers watching one another with mutual suspicion, which made the north one of the most deeply fragmented regions of the Five Dynasties; there, governors repeatedly murdered their own superiors to refuse central appointments, and the north stayed unsettled for a long time. At the level of method, two devices of this campaign were taken up afterwards: the siege by cutting the defender's water supply in place of a direct assault, and the combination of standing on the city, cutting the water and buying over subordinates in order to isolate a rival commander, the first of which recurs in the many sieges between the Tang and the Song, while the second became the standing method of Tang jiedushi campaigning against their peers. In arms, the rectangular shield tradition continued here, holding on until the late Tang, when the rectangular shield gave way by degrees to the round shield and the armour of the central body.
result: 結局是攻守兩方都沒有得到想要的東西。田悅自二月兵敗退回魏州，官軍未能破城，戰事轉為長期圍城與拉鋸；他派出的使者雖說動朱滔與王武俊計畫出兵相救，兩人卻各有自己的藩鎮算盤，援軍並未如約在城外援戰中出現，田悅只能靠孤城與城內殘兵自守。另一方面，官軍也付出了明白的代價：田悅的殘部自洹水退回時只餘千餘人，兩個月後卻能集結二萬，背城列陣，說明魏博的基層動員能力與地方控制仍在；唐廷對河北道用兵，反把河北各鎮逼得更緊，張孝忠、王武俊、康日知等一批新任命的大員在河北重新劃界立鎮，把原本可以統合的藩鎮拆得更碎。就本役的直接結果而言，雙方在魏州城下僵持，戰局要等到德宗朝後續對淮西、淄青用兵以及沙陀援軍介入才逐漸解決，魏州則長期留在田氏節度使手上，成為後來河北割據的根據地之一，而德宗朝削藩的綱領也在這場無法速勝的圍城下被再打折扣。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted. After the defeat in the second month Tian Yue fell back into Weizhou; the imperial army could not take the city, and the campaign turned into a long blockade and a grinding stalemate. His emissaries did talk Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun into promising relief, but each of the two had his own calculations as a circuit governor, the relief never appeared in strength outside the walls, and Tian Yue could only hold on with the isolated city and the men left inside it. The imperial side paid a price of its own, clearly visible in the figures: the remnants who fled back from Huanqiu numbered little more than a thousand, yet two months later Tian Yue could muster twenty thousand and deploy them against the walls, which shows that the basic mobilisation capacity and local control of Weibo had survived; and the court's war in Hebei, by pressing the circuits harder, drove them together more tightly, while a new set of appointees such as Zhang Xiaozhong, Wang Wujun and Kang Rizhi redrew the boundaries and established new offices in Hebei, breaking into even smaller pieces a grouping that might otherwise have held together. The immediate result of the campaign was thus a stalemate before the walls of Weizhou. The war was not settled until the later campaigns against Huai west and Ziqing and the arrival of Shatuo auxiliaries during the Dezong reign, and Weizhou stayed in the hands of the Tian line of governors for a long time, becoming one of the bases of the later partition of Hebei; what the drawn-out siege did was to put a further discount on the whole programme of curbing the governors that had been the court's slogan since Jianzhong.
